doc.title: X-ray Tube · a live technical plate
el.name: TUNGSTEN
title: X-RAY TUBE
subtitle: One percent becomes X-rays.
intro: Electrons strike a spinning tungsten track. Under 1 % of their energy leaves as X-rays; the rest is heat the disc, the oil and the housing must carry away.
rating.title: TUBE RATING
cooling.title: ANODE COOLING
card.title: ON THE BENCH
narr.expose: Pushed and pulled by {half} kV each side, electrons hit tungsten at {beta} c.
foot.note: An independent study based on the published datasheet of a 150 kV, 300 kHU rotating-anode tube; not affiliated with any manufacturer.
narr.idle: Cold and still. Press PREP and the target starts to spin.
narr.prep: In 1.2 s the tungsten disc goes from rest to 9,700 rpm.
narr.brake: Release: a DC brake stops the rotor in 3 s.
narr.lock.rating: Interlock: {kw} kW for {ms} ms is above the tube rating.
narr.lock.current: Interlock: the filament cannot give {ma} mA at {kv} kV.
narr.lock.heat: Anode too hot. Exposure refused until it cools.
narr.filament: The filament glows white hot; a cloud of electrons waits in the cup.
narr.brems: Braking hard near tungsten nuclei, electrons shed energy as X-rays.
narr.klines: Past 69.5 kV the K shell is knocked open: spikes at 59 and 67 keV.
narr.heat: Under 1 % becomes X-rays. The rest is heat.
narr.spin: The spot stays put, the disc moves: 16 turns in 0.1 s spread the heat round a ring.
narr.linefocus: A 12° bevel: 5.8 mm of track looks like a 1.2 mm spot from the patient.
narr.full: At 75 kW the 210 kJ anode is full in 2.8 seconds.
narr.cool: It sheds at most 475 W: full to half takes over five minutes.
narr.view.housing: Sealed, oil-filled and lead-lined: 476 mm of cast housing, earthed all round.
narr.view.cutaway: Cut open: oil, a glass vacuum insert, the cathode on the left, the spinning anode on the right.
narr.view.beam: A 12° bevel: 5.8 mm of track looks like a 1.2 mm spot from the patient.
narr.view.exploded: Housing, oil, glass insert, cathode, disc, rotor: taken apart.
narr.wait.exploded: Waiting for the rotor to stop before taking it apart.
narr.view.image: It has one job: this picture. White is bone, black is the air in the lungs.
narr.useshot: It has one job: this picture. White is bone, black is the air in the lungs.
narr.useshot2: Turn kV up and bone fades while the lungs show more: why chest films use high kV.
narr.image.ready: Chest program: {kv} kV, {mas} mAs at 180 cm. Press EXPOSE.
